scope: Ukrainian-created expense, personal-budget, shared-expense, business-expense, vehicle-cost and household-utility trackers. Public native store listings are separated from web products, beta releases, unavailable apps and unresolved origin leads.
method: Reviewed AppMap fintech and Osyo Ukrainian budget directories.
Cross-checked DOU first-person creator announcements, Ukrainian technology reporting, official creator sites and official Apple/Google listings.
Accepted explicit Ukrainian creator/team statements or developer/operator country evidence; did not infer origin from names, language support or storefront country.

Matched exact store identifiers to separate similarly named products and rebrands. Reconciled every Ukrainian-made tag against final platform catalogs and per-record origin provenance; recorded source, basis and check date for each listing. Same-name matches alone were not used to group products.

Incorporated final platform audits: official provider/developer country disclosures, Ukrainian storefront discovery searches, creator statements and independent product reporting. Sources establish a documented Ukrainian connection, not the nationality of every contributor.
limitations: A broad discovery audit, not an exhaustive registry. Public directories and search results can miss small, delisted or newly released apps. Unverified cases remain visible here rather than being labeled Ukrainian without evidence.
